100M daily users x 50 engagement events/day
  = 5B events/day (~58,000 events/sec average)

-- a viral moment can spike that 100x on a few posts
caption: Volume, not logical complexity, is the design problem.

eyebrow: Sharding by content_id, not by time
code:
By content_id hash:  hash(content_id) % N
  --> a viral post's writes spread across all N shards
By time bucket only:
  --> all of today's viral-post writes hit ONE bucket
caption: The spike doesn't hit the system evenly -- it hits one post.
